Support

Luvani is an app for practising spoken French with an AI tutor.

An address for support is not set yet, so this page is not ready to be published.

Managing your subscription

Subscriptions are handled by the App Store, under your Apple Account, and can be cancelled there at any time.

Deleting your account

Settings inside the app has Delete account. It removes your account and the learning tied to it.

Getting your data

Settings also has Download my data, which writes a file with everything we hold for you.
